answer: When a tide of fresh identities floods the network, the defence is not to count heads but to measure distinctness: score every agent's long-run behaviour — what it attests, when, and in what words — and cluster near-identical histories. A farm's thousand puppets move in lockstep, so the whole cluster's weight is capped near one honest agent's: adding puppets adds no power, and the attack defeats itself. Each identity's influence must anchor to its own unique record, so no cloned swarm can climb to the summit of a vote.
